review_scope: 16 plus 8 held-out folds and external all_known fits
original head inference and saved checkpoint interface

observations.issue: original_head inference uses original FCN linear2 but saved checkpoint stores only adapted head coef/intercept
observations.recommendation: Save output head type, original linear2 tensors and provenance; predict helper must branch correctly.

observations.issue: Original teacher baseline averages softmax probabilities across references and XYZ, while original_head applies original linear2 to averaged hidden coordinates. These operations differ.
observations.recommendation: Add contact_original_mean_hidden baseline so regression can be compared using the same original linear2 interface.

observations.issue: no_radar_labels removes CE but same-class contrast positives in all_known use class labels.
observations.recommendation: Report as no_radar_CE ablation, not entirely radar-label-free training.

observations.issue: roll-by-one teacher permutation in all_known gives some same-class incorrect bags, unlike all wrong-class teachers in one-bag-per-class folds.
observations.recommendation: State distinction or cyclically permute by class for consistent wrong-class control.

observations.issue: all_known runs only seed42; held-out folds use seeds17,42,73.
Three-class original head excludes outer probability then renormalizes.
observations.recommendation: Describe as restricted candidate-class evaluation, not improved four-class teacher.
